mechanics.claim: Regurgitate deals magic damage based on the target's maximum health only when the swallowed champion is an enemy.
mechanics.quote: If they are an enemy, he deals {{as|magic damage}} to them at the end of the displacement.

mechanics.claim: The damage instance occurs at the end of the spit displacement, not at the moment of casting Regurgitate.
mechanics.quote: deals {{as|magic damage}} to them at the end of the displacement

mechanics.claim: Devour can only be cast on enemies who have 3 stacks of the passive.
mechanics.quote: ''Devour'' can only be cast on enemies with 3 stacks of ''{{ai|An Acquired Taste|Tahm Kench}}''.

mechanics.claim: If the target is an ally, Devour grants a shield instead of dealing damage.
mechanics.quote: If the target is an ally, they become {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} and are granted a {{tip|shield}}

mechanics.claim: The shield decays in strength by 50 every 0.25 seconds after the ally is Regurgitated.
mechanics.quote: which decays in strength by 50 every {{fd|0.25}} seconds after they are ''{{ai|Regurgitate|Tahm Kench|Regurgitated}}''

mechanics.claim: Regurgitate automatically casts after Devour's swallow duration ends, or can be manually cast after 1 second.
mechanics.quote: After 1 second, '''Tahm Kench''' can cast ''{{ai|Regurgitate|Tahm Kench}}'' while a target is inside of his belly, and automatically does so after the duration.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown for Devour starts post-effect (after Regurgitate resolves), and the time spent active reduces the cooldown afterward.
mechanics.quote: Starts post-effect, but time spent active will be reduced by current cooldown afterwards
